### Landman (2024) — Greed, Power & The Dangerous Price of Success 🛢️

Landman is a drama series starring Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris, an experienced crisis manager working in the high-stakes oil industry of West Texas. Surrounded by wealthy executives, hardworking oil crews, and dangerous business partners, Tommy must navigate a world where enormous fortunes are built on risk, pressure, and difficult decisions.

As the oil business grows more complicated, Tommy faces deadly accidents, criminal threats, corporate rivalries, and unexpected family problems. Every decision carries consequences, and one mistake can put everything at risk. While powerful people fight to control the money, Tommy struggles to keep the business running without losing control of his own life.

The series explores ambition, greed, loyalty, family, and the consequences of chasing wealth. It reveals how the pursuit of power can push people into dangerous situations and how success often comes with sacrifices that money cannot easily repair.

What makes Landman compelling is its intense look at the people behind the oil industry. Beneath the wealth and influence lies a world where survival requires experience, strategy, and the ability to handle pressure when everything starts falling apart.

💬 “Everyone wants a piece of the fortune, but not everyone is ready to pay the price.”

source_details.synopsis: Landman is an American drama series created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, inspired by the podcast series Boomtown hosted by Wallace. Starring Billy Bob Thornton as a landman for an oil company, the show premiered on November 17, 2024, on Paramount+. In March 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on November 16, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a third season. Despite some elements igniting controversy, the series has been received positively by critics overall.
